VALIDATION TEST CASES: complete-architecture-separation

These are historical test cases that validate the three-component architecture separation.
They can be run WITHOUT LLM - pure static analysis and integration tests.

=== TEST CASE 1: Zero ML Keywords in metabob-opencode ===

Input:
  testType: "grep"
  repo: "repos/metabob-opencode"
  pattern: "thompson|beta_distribution|sampleBeta|sampleGamma|pattern_extraction"
  excludePatterns: ["thompsonSampling:", "// Reference", "Thompson Sampling delegated"]

ExpectedOutput:
  pass: true
  matchCount: 0
  reason: "Zero ML keywords found in opencode (only metadata references)"

=== TEST CASE 2: Zero Training Logic in metabob-cli ===

Input:
  testType: "grep"
  repo: "repos/metabob-cli"
  pattern: "train|fit_model|sampleBeta|sampleGamma"
  excludePatterns: ["constraints"]

ExpectedOutput:
  pass: true
  matchCount: 0
  reason: "Zero training logic found in CLI"

=== TEST CASE 3: All Thompson Sampling in metabob-rpc-api ===

Input:
  testType: "grep"
  repo: "repos/metabob-rpc-api"
  pattern: "select_variant_thompson_sampling|thompson_alpha|thompson_beta"
  minMatches: 40

ExpectedOutput:
  pass: true
  matchCount: >= 40
  reason: "All Thompson Sampling logic correctly located in RPC API"

=== TEST CASE 4: Data Flow via HTTP (CLI → RPC API) ===

Input:
  testType: "grep"
  repo: "repos/metabob-cli"
  pattern: "http://localhost:8080|METABOB_RPC_API_URL|rpc.*api"
  minMatches: 40

ExpectedOutput:
  pass: true
  matchCount: >= 40
  reason: "CLI correctly acts as gateway with HTTP calls to RPC API"

=== TEST CASE 5: thompson-sampler.ts File Deleted ===

Input:
  testType: "file-exists"
  file: "repos/metabob-opencode/packages/opencode/src/ml/thompson-sampler.ts"

ExpectedOutput:
  pass: true
  fileExists: false
  reason: "thompson-sampler.ts correctly deleted from opencode"

=== TEST CASE 6: template-selector.ts Delegates to RPC API ===

Input:
  testType: "file-content"
  file: "repos/metabob-opencode/packages/opencode/src/session/template-selector.ts"
  requiredStrings:
    - "delegating Thompson Sampling to metabob-rpc-api"
    - "POST /v2/activities/templates/{id}/select"
    - "Thompson Sampling (Beta distribution sampling) now happens in metabob-rpc-api"

ExpectedOutput:
  pass: true
  missingStrings: []
  reason: "template-selector.ts correctly delegates Thompson Sampling to RPC API"

=== TEST CASE 7: activity.ts Has No Thompson Sampling Calculations ===

Input:
  testType: "file-content"
  file: "repos/metabob-opencode/packages/opencode/src/tool/activity.ts"
  forbiddenStrings:
    - "const thompsonAlpha = successCount + 1"
    - "const thompsonBeta = failureCount + 1"
    - "thompsonAlpha / (thompsonAlpha + thompsonBeta)"

ExpectedOutput:
  pass: true
  foundStrings: []
  reason: "activity.ts correctly has no Thompson Sampling calculations"

=== TEST CASE 8: MCP Tools in CLI are Pure Proxies ===

Input:
  testType: "file-content"
  file: "repos/metabob-cli/src/metabob_cli/mcp/tools.py"
  requiredPattern: "call_api"
  minOccurrences: 5

ExpectedOutput:
  pass: true
  occurrences: >= 5
  reason: "MCP tools correctly use call_api proxy"

=== TEST CASE 9: RPC API Has select_variant_thompson_sampling Endpoint ===

Input:
  testType: "file-content"
  file: "repos/metabob-rpc-api/server/actions/activity.py"
  requiredStrings:
    - "def select_variant_thompson_sampling"
    - "sample_beta"
    - "alpha"
    - "beta"

ExpectedOutput:
  pass: true
  missingStrings: []
  reason: "RPC API correctly implements select_variant_thompson_sampling"

=== TEST CASE 10: SurrealDB Schema Has Required Tables ===

Input:
  testType: "file-content"
  file: "initialize-surrealdb-schema.sql"
  requiredTables:
    - "activity_execution"
    - "template_metrics"
    - "activity_template"

ExpectedOutput:
  pass: true
  missingTables: []
  reason: "SurrealDB schema has all required tables"

=== SUMMARY ===

Total Test Cases: 10
Coverage:
  - Code structure validation: 7 cases
  - API contract validation: 2 cases
  - Database schema validation: 1 case

All tests are deterministic and can run without LLM.
Tests validate architectural boundaries at multiple levels:
  - File existence/deletion
  - Code pattern presence/absence
  - Configuration and schema compliance
